text: I think you'll enjoy the Hot Buttered Garlic Noodles recipe, given your fondness for savory flavors and ingredients like garlic and olive oil. Although it doesn't feature oregano or chicken, which are staples in many of your liked recipes, the combination of butter, garlic, and noodles might appeal to your taste buds. The recipe's quick preparation time and relatively low nutritional content also make it a reasonable choice, considering the average time budget of your liked recipes.
